Vaani.voice.wake_word#

Wake Word Detector - Offline Voice Activation#

Features: - Offline wake word detection using Vosk - Runs continuously in background thread - Low CPU usage (~5% on modern systems) - No internet required for wake word detection - Fuzzy matching for accent variations - Multiple wake word support (‘vani’, ‘vaani’, ‘bani’, ‘wani’) - Thread-safe callback system - Automatic model loading with helpful download instructions - Brief pause after detection to prevent multiple triggers

Privacy-focused offline wake word detection that continuously listens for activation phrases without sending any data to the cloud.
